subject: Obsidian Spark — Draft MAP and proposed timeline update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@obsidianspark.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Obsidian Spark — Draft MAP and next steps

Hi Ethan / Maya (looping Maya on procurement),

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion on integration scope and success criteria. As promised, attached is our initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (ObsidianSpark_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx). High-level recap & asks below: 

- Target close (initial plan): 2027-06-30.
- Key milestones in the draft:
  - Security questionnaire completed (customer inputs) — owner: Obsidian Spark
  - Pilot environment deployment & validation — owner: Redwood (Ben)
  - Contract redlines complete — owner: Obsidian Spark legal + Redwood sales
  - PO issuance / procurement signoff — owner: Obsidian Spark procurement

Open items / dependencies:
- SOC 2 evidence: customer indicated they need confirmation of our controls. We can provide attestations and logs; Rishi can lead the security packet.
- Integration acceptance tests: we sketched an initial checklist in the MAP; need to confirm success criteria by next week.

Next steps / asks:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm owners and any missing milestones by EOD Thu 11 Feb.
2) If procurement has any timeline constraints, can Maya share the procurement cutoffs for Q2/Q3?
3) We'll schedule a joint kickoff after we settle owners and the target close.

I set the target close to 2027-06-30 in v1 to reflect your original timeline on the call — if that looks off, call it out and we'll update.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for LLMs

Attachment: ObsidianSpark_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@obsidianspark.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@obsidianspark.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Obsidian Spark — Draft MAP and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from procurement / finance: they're running a revised budget cadence this year and Q2 procurement approvals are already committed to several vendor renewals. Two immediate asks / constraints: 

1) Procurement has a firm PO cutoff for Q2 spend on 2027-03-15. Anything not in the current quarter will need to be budgeted for Q3, which begins 2027-07-01.
2) We also need at least preliminary SOC 2 evidence (controls summary + relevant logs) to present to our security committee before they greenlight a PO.

Given that, we likely need to move the target close out to mid-August (tentative target: 2027-08-15). I want to avoid giving you a moving date until I confirm with finance on the exact PO timing — I'll escalate internally and follow up by next week.

I'm attaching a short procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf) to show the constraints.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the MAP — we'll review and come back with owner confirmations.

—Ethan
Ethan Wu
Head of Platform Engineering | Obsidian Spark
ethan.wu@obsidianspark.com | +1 212-555-0911

Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Internal — Replan MAP for Obsidian Spark (Q3 close target)

Team — FYI / quick replan based on Ethan's procurement update. He flagged the PO window and SOC 2 ask; likely new close target is 2027-08-15. Proposed adjustments below (internal notes attached: MAP_internal_reprioritize_notes.docx):

Proposed MAP changes (v2):
- New target close: 2027-08-15 (move out from 2027-06-30).
- Priority 1 (dependency-driven): Security evidence packet (SOC 2 summary, control list, sample logs) — owner: Rishi. Delivery target: 2027-06-15 to give customer time to review.
- Priority 2: Contract redlines + T&Cs — owner: Ben. Aim to complete redlines by 2027-07-15 so procurement can start PO process.
- Priority 3: Pilot deployment & acceptance tests — owner: Redwood Solutions (Sergio) with support from Ben. Begin staging on 2027-07-01, acceptance by 2027-07-31.

Action items (who does what):
- Rishi: prepare security packet + point-person for any follow-up questions (due 2027-06-15).
- Ben: lead contract redline turnaround and propose fallback language for data retention and SLA (due 2027-07-15).
- Sergio: confirm resource window for pilot and create an integration checklist (kickoff 2027-07-01).
- Marissa: update MAP and send v2 to customer with new dates / ask for confirmation by Fri 18 Feb.

Risks / notes: 
- If we can't produce SOC 2 artifacts by mid-June, customer may push close further into Q4. Prioritize the security packet to keep Q3 realistic.
- We should prepare a concise one-page SOC2 summary for procurement / security committee.

I'll attach the internal notes and a v2 skeleton; please confirm availability and any blockers by EOD Thu.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: MAP_internal_reprioritize_notes.docx (DOCX, 8KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Obsidian Spark — Updated MAP (v2) and new milestone dates (request confirmation)

Hi Ethan / Maya —

Per our internal re-prioritization, attached is MAP v2 (ObsidianSpark_MAP_v2.xlsx). Highlights of changes from v1: 

- New target close: 2027-08-15 (customer-proposed).
- Security packet (SOC2 summary + sample evidence) moved to top of the plan — target delivery 2027-06-15 (owner: Rishi).
- Contract redline turnaround targeted for 2027-07-15 (owner: Ben).
- Pilot acceptance plan shifted to July with staging starting 2027-07-01 (owner: Sergio).

We included a compact timeline and explicit owners on the first sheet. Related links: HubSpot deal HS-9876543 and our shared Drive folder (link below).

Ask: can you confirm owners and the proposed close date by EOD Thu 18 Feb so we can lock resources and commit to the schedule? If procurement needs an earlier artifact for the security committee, flag the specific doc and we'll prioritize.

If the timeline looks correct, I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for the week of 2027-06-28 to align on pilot success criteria and test plan.

Thanks — and feel free to call if you want to walk the plan together.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Obsidian Spark — Updated MAP (v2) and new milestone dates (request confirmation)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated MAP. Confirming the revised timeline / owners look good from our side:

- SOC2 evidence: target delivery by Rishi on or before 2027-06-15 — we'll present to security committee the week of 2027-06-21.
- Contract redlines: Ben and our legal will aim to complete by 2027-07-15.
- Pilot staging / acceptance: we have engineering capacity starting 2027-07-01.
- Target close: confirmed 2027-08-15 (we'll push to get PO issued by 2027-07-30).

I'll escalate a hard date for the PO internally and update Maya's procurement plan accordingly. If anything shifts on our end I'll update the thread, but for now please move forward with v2 and schedule the June kickoff.

Appreciate the clarity — we'll be in touch if procurement needs additional artifacts sooner.

—Ethan
